title: 10 Years AWS User Group Vienna - hosted by ByteSource
summary: Celebrate 10 Years of Cloud Innovation in Vienna!
description:
**Celebrate 10 Years of Cloud Innovation in Vienna!**

Join us for a **special AWS User Group Vienna Meetup** celebrating a decade of cloud innovation and community building!

 **Location**
ÖBB Open Innovation Factory
Lassallestraße 5, Foyer 1
1020 Wien

 **When**
**Wednesday, November 5th, 2025**
Doors open at **17:00** for networking, food & drinks.
Talks start at **18:00**.

** Event Highlights**

* Meet the **AWS Heroes of Austria**, including **Nana Janashia** from *TechWorld with Nana*
* Connect with **AWS Community Builders** from Vienna and across Austria
* Celebrate **outstanding community members** with special awards
* Network with fellow **cloud enthusiasts and builders**

** Agenda**
**17:00 - 18:00**: Entry & Networking
**18:00 - 18:05**: Welcome and Introduction AWS Community Vienna
**18:05 - 18:15**: Welcome and Introduction to the sponsors
**18:15 - 18:30**: Past 10 Years in DevOps - Nana Janashia
**18:30 - 18:45**: Networking Break
**18:45 - 19:15**: Elevating Event Photography Workflow with AWS - Case Study from AWS Community Day DACH - Dmytro Hlotenko
**19:15 - 19:20**: Intro to the Community Builder Program - Dmytro Hlotenko
**19:20 - 19:35**: AWS Community DACH Overview and How to Contribute - Linda Mohamed
**19:35 - 20:00**: Networking Break
**20:00 - 20:05**: Sebastian Eckler, AWS
**20:05 - 20:30**: AWS User Group Vienna Recap
**20:30 - 21:00**: Awards Ceremony
**21:00 - Open End**: Networking

***

Don’t miss this milestone event - **RSVP now** and invite your colleagues to celebrate, learn, and connect with the AWS community!
By RSVPing, you confirm that you agree to our **[Code of Conduct](http://aws-meetup-vie.s3-website.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/AWS_Meetup_Vienna-Code_Of_Conduct.pdf)**.
